canDoYue: 你識叫人換錶電池、問開底之後仲防唔防水、留住金屬錶帶、拆兩節、四點取，仲有一年保養。
canDoEn: Ask for a watch battery, check that it stays water resistant, keep the metal band, remove two links, and collect it at four under a one-year warranty.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: My watch has stopped. Can you change the battery?
dialogue.glossYue: 我隻錶停咗。可唔可以換電池？
dialogue.say: My watch has stopped. Can you change the battery?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Sure. It takes about ten minutes, and it's eighty dollars.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。大約十分鐘，八十蚊。
dialogue.say: Sure. It takes about ten minutes, and it's eighty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Will it still be water resistant after you open the back?
dialogue.glossYue: 你開咗底之後，仲防唔防水？
dialogue.say: Will it still be water resistant after you open the back?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes, we reseal it and test it. Do you want to keep the metal band?
dialogue.glossYue: 會，我哋會重新密封同測試。你想留住金屬錶帶嗎？
dialogue.say: Yes, we reseal it and test it. Do you want to keep the metal band?

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: It's a bit loose. Can you take out two links?
dialogue.glossYue: 有啲鬆。可唔可以拆走兩節？
dialogue.say: It's a bit loose. Can you take out two links?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: No problem. That's free with the battery change.
dialogue.glossYue: 冇問題。連埋換電池一齊做，唔使另收費。
dialogue.say: No problem. That's free with the battery change.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Great. When can I pick it up?
dialogue.say: Great. When can I pick it up?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Come back at four. The new battery has a one-year warranty.
dialogue.glossYue: 四點再嚟。新電池有一年保養。
dialogue.say: Come back at four. The new battery has a one-year warranty.
